summary: Add bounded canonical JSON and scoped identity property tests
details: Add seven seeded fuzz targets for normalized hash stability, bounded JSON and duplicate decoded keys, tenant object identities and idempotency record encodings.
Preserve the historical float64 hash profile and readable legacy keys while testing exact round trips, tenant prefix separation and changed-field detection.
Bound input work in the foundational targets and existing digest fuzzers, and add a source coverage floor alongside behavioral seed and campaign checks.

compatibility.notes: Test and documentation changes only; production parsing, authorization, hashing and key formats are unchanged.

security: Exercise ambiguous JSON rejection and scoped identity serialization without changing production trust boundaries or using credentials, providers or customer data.
limitations: Bounded fuzz runs supplement existing deterministic regression vectors and do not prove complete parser, authorization or cryptographic assurance.
Complete target accounting, evidence parser and verifier campaigns, and scheduled fuzzing remain tracked by EVY-1104 and its remaining child tickets.
